slides.sub: A gluten-free kitchen, a from-scratch bakery and a coffee shop with books, 2 roads apart.

slides.title: Defying Gravitea
slides.body: A scratch kitchen with a gluten-free and dairy-free menu. The owner turned her family's Italian recipes into GF and DF versions, and a full brunch menu launched in 2026.

slides.title: Chapters & Coffee
slides.body: Coffee, tea and books to read. The lattes have book-themed names, like The Story Teller, a cookie butter latte with vanilla cold foam.

slides.title: Francesca's Bakery
slides.body: Baked goods and custom cakes made by hand from scratch, with no added preservatives. The bakery says most of its ingredients come from local farmers.

slides.title: One Saturday in Pequannock
slides.tip: There's no train station in town. Lincoln Park station is nearby. Time that drive at rush hour.
